definitions.explanation: A scheduled transport service such as a plane flight, bus, or delivery run. Also used as a counter for such services.

examples.japanese: {午前|ごぜん}の{便|びん}は{満席|まんせき}だった。
examples.english: The morning flight was fully booked.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}で{多|おお}くの{便|びん}が{欠航|けっこう}になった。
examples.english: Many flights were cancelled because of the typhoon.

notes:
Refers to a single run of a regular transport or delivery service. Read べん in other senses (convenience, bowel movement), which are treated separately.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {直行便|ちょっこうびん}: a direct flight
- {定期便|ていきびん}: a regular/scheduled service
- {臨時便|りんじびん}: an extra (unscheduled) service
- {始発便|しはつびん}: the first departure of the day
- {便|びん}が{欠航|けっこう}になる: a flight is cancelled
